correctionsAppliedThisFreeze: Added atlas_repository_identity.source_authority_repo_id (text, UNIQUE, and UNIQUE with repository_id) -- bridges the new UUID repository identity to the existing live text repo_id namespace ('deeds-web-app', etc.) without declaring that text key to be the future logical identity itself.

atlas_stable_file_revision_binding now carries repository_id, source_authority_repo_id, canonical_source_ref (renamed from repository_relative_path to match atlas_workspace_source_bindings' own column name, making the FK direct rather than a value-matching assumption).

Two FKs added: (repository_id, source_authority_repo_id) -> atlas_repository_identity, and (source_authority_repo_id, canonical_source_ref, source_revision, workspace_revision) -> atlas_workspace_source_bindings (repo_id, canonical_source_ref, source_revision, workspace_revision) -- confirmed live this gate: that exact UNIQUE constraint (atlas_workspace_source_bindin_repo_id_canonical_source_ref__key) already exists, so the FK is directly buildable, not hypothetical.

Path index changed from a bare repository_relative_path index (implied global path identity) to a scoped (repository_id, canonical_source_ref, workspace_revision) index -- src/index.ts in repo A is never confused with src/index.ts in repo B.

atlas_repository_identity now distinguishes repository_kind ('ROOT'|'NESTED_GIT_REPOSITORY') with repository_name/repository_path as the canonical fields and gitmodule_name kept as OPTIONAL metadata -- the root repository is no longer forced to pretend to be a gitmodule.

atlas_stable_file_alias's valid_from_revision/valid_to_revision (which implied ordering on non-orderable sha256 content hashes) renamed to introduced_in_workspace_revision/superseded_in_workspace_revision, with NO ordering CHECK (< / >) added -- only presence/nullability. Workspace revisions have an admission-order authority elsewhere (the workspace-revision-tournament-admission process already used this session), unlike raw content-hash source_revision values, which have no ordering relationship at all.
